finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts::many stderr error-envelope emitters bypass `outputerror`, so they still print pretty-printed multi-line json with no `command` — breaking the one-line/attributed contract this change documents and tests
evidence: Verified against the supplied sources: docs.ts (~line 195 and ~255) emits `console.error(JSON.stringify(body, null, 2))` with no `command`; docs/import.ts and schema.ts likewise emit pretty-printed envelopes bypassing outputError. The README updated in this PR documents "a single JSON line on stderr" with `command` unconditionally, so the described divergence is genuinely present. Severity is tempered because the PR's own task doc explicitly scopes these hand-rolled emitters out to issues #654/#655 — it is a known, pre-existing, tracked gap rather than a regression — but the documented contract vs. actual behavior mismatch the claim describes exists in the code as written.
